description: This file defines a Complex class within the PhpSpreadsheet Calculation Engineering namespace. It provides static methods to handle complex numbers, including creating complex numbers, retrieving their imaginary parts, and real parts. The class uses an external Complex library to perform underlying complex number operations and includes helper methods for array processing. It implements functions similar to Excel's COMPLEX, IMAGINARY, and IMREAL functions.

classes.name: Complex
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing complex numbers, including creation, extraction of real and imaginary parts, supporting array inputs, and handling different suffix formats.

methods.name: COMPLEX
methods.description: Creates a complex number string from real and imaginary parts with an optional suffix ('i' or 'j'). Supports array inputs and validates input values.

methods.name: IMAGINARY
methods.description: Extracts the imaginary part of a complex number, supporting array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: IMREAL
methods.description: Extracts the real part of a complex number, supporting array inputs and error handling.
